roles.name: ux-designer
roles.description: Product and UX thinking partner for Dristi. Read relevant current sources, brainstorm with the owner, and recommend behavior and acceptance criteria. No application or archive edits.

roles.name: ui-designer
roles.description: Build agreed Dristi behavior using the pinned Pucar DS. Own assigned implementation, relevant states, and validation; report evidence to the coordinator.

roles.name: ui-reviewer
roles.description: Independently review agreed Dristi behavior, DS consistency, accessibility, and responsive usability. Report required fixes, suggestions, and missing evidence without modifying files.

rules.name: pucar-design-system
rules.description: Before Dristi UI planning, building, or review, use the pinned Pucar DS and the applicable checks.

rules.name: dev-server
rules.description: Protect the owner’s running server and other checkouts; use localhost only for the verified checkout.
